newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers unchanged.

text.p: Most soymeal basis offers were unchanged Thursday, with values supported by expectations for a drop in the pace of the weekly U.S. crush, brokers said.
"It will be interesting to see what happens with the crush," one Indiana dealer said. "It had better go down some."

The National Oilseed Processor Association will release its weekly crush tally Thursday afternoon, and most in the trade expect it to be down slightly from last week's crush of 26.2 million bushels of soybeans.
Trade estimates for this week's crush ranged from 25 million to 25.95 million bushels.
Supplies of soymeal were growing heavy in some markets. Brokers reported large amounts of unsold soymeal on railroad tracks in the Illinois market.
Soymeal offers in Kansas City were up sharply in anticipation of diminished soymeal supplies in that market, brokers said.
Cargill's plant there will be shut beginning May 1 through August, a Cargill spokeswoman confirmed earlier.
